scope: ADDITIVE to spec/design-tokens.json — new tokens introduced by the Settings editor. Everything not listed here is unchanged.
note: Palette in the session brief is the pre-2026-07-26 set; spec/design-tokens.json holds the current values.

--fail.why: --live means 'this is happening now' (live draft). --fail means 'something broke'. Sharing one colour would make a failed job read as urgency and a live draft read as an error.

--hatch.why: a pattern, not a colour — survives greyscale and colour-blindness, which a tint would not

fresh.means: computed under the settings in force

stale.means: a real number, computed under settings this league no longer has
stale.policy: keep showing the number — a wrong-but-labelled value beats a hole, and blanking makes a settings change feel like data loss

nullState.means: no value exists: never computed, or not computable for this player
nullState.policy: no hatch — there is nothing to invalidate

criticalDistinction: stale vs null, not stale vs fresh — a stale number looks plausible and a null one does not

editedValueTreatment.rule: never collapse the pair into one number — same rule as the availability baseline/live pair
